scope: Measured iOS 27.0 behavior; not a guarantee for other iOS releases.

fulfilledPostEndUnmuteEvidence.callkit: Measured fulfilled post-end unmute still times out in 5.0–5.9 s.
fulfilledPostEndUnmuteEvidence.livecommunicationkit: Measured no timeout through 5.542 s after fulfilled post-end unmute; terminal settlement follows public fulfill/complete semantics, not a measured infinite observation.

lckActionDeadlineEvidence.measured: 24 lck.perform timeoutDate samples are 30 seconds. cx-after has no LCK deliveries; its later CX provider owns the actions.
lckActionDeadlineEvidence.expiryPolicy: The advertised LCK timeoutDate remains 30 seconds. #85 measured effective Pause/End expiry near 5.3 s and Join expiry near 64 s in system waiting-call composites; see lckMultiCall. Runtime expiry at 30 s for other LCK action kinds remains unverified.

lckMultiCall.timingInterpretation: Representative runtime samples and aggregate medians, not minimum delays or guaranteed bounds. Join median 115 ms (9–239 ms); audio gap median 213 ms (151–404 ms without delayed constituents). Pause 110 ms and deactivation 120 ms are representative delivery-relative samples; resume-generated End 91 ms is relative to Resume delivery.

evidence.systemComposite: Constituents of 28 system waiting-call composites arrived within 0–3 ms. Accepted Join followed every constituent terminal settlement; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/README.md; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/ha-delay-pause.jsonl; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/ha-reverse.jsonl.
evidence.pauseBeforeFulfillment: Pause state appeared about 110 ms after delivery while Pause remained unfulfilled for 2 s; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/ha-delay-pause.jsonl; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/ha-pending-pause.jsonl.
evidence.effectiveExpiry: timeoutDate advertised 30 s; Pause/End timedOut near 5.3 s, Join near 64 s; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/ha-pending-pause.jsonl; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/ea-pending-end.jsonl; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/ha-pending-join.jsonl.
evidence.failedPause: Failed Pause ended A and delivered cleanup End A; B joined; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/ha-fail-pause.jsonl.
evidence.failedJoin: Failed Join ended B and delivered cleanup End B while A stayed paused; End & Accept lost both calls; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/ha-fail-join.jsonl; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/ea-fail-join.jsonl.
evidence.failedEnd: Failed End was ignored: A left and B joined, without retry. Pending End expiry was terminal too; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/ea-fail-end.jsonl; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/ea-pending-end.jsonl.
evidence.cleanupEnd: Cleanup End arrived after the conversation had left. Immediate fulfillment still produced timedOut about 5.2 s later; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/ha-fail-pause.jsonl; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/ha-pending-join.jsonl.
evidence.noAutomaticResume: Ending B left A paused until the application acted; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/hold-accept.jsonl; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/ha-fail-join.jsonl.
evidence.choices: Hold & Accept required maximumConversationGroups >= 2 and a free group. Full groups offered End & Accept, Decline and End Held & Accept; merging did not free a group. End Held & Accept delivered Pause B, End A and Join C; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/cap-1x1.jsonl; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/cap-1x2.jsonl; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/cap-2x2.jsonl; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/third-end-held-accept.jsonl.
evidence.outgoingCapacity: Outgoing Start at capacity returned com.apple.CallKit.error.requesttransaction 7 after 11–206 ms; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/cap-1x1.jsonl; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/cap-1x2.jsonl.
evidence.capabilities: No capabilities, or removing pausing mid-call, gated neither waiting choices nor app Pause; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/caps-none.jsonl; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/caps-toggle.jsonl.
evidence.mergeAndUnmerge: App Merge/Unmerge were accepted and delivered without conversation state changes, including singleton Unmerge and Merge into a ringing target. LCK exposes no group membership; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/merge-b-into-a.jsonl; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/merge-a-into-b.jsonl; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/unmerge-singleton.jsonl; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/cap-2x1.jsonl.
evidence.appResume: With 2x1, app Resume A joined A, then a distinct generated End B arrived 91 ms after Resume delivery. Shared transaction composition was not observable; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/swap-app.jsonl.
evidence.audioAndQueue: Callbacks arrived on main; normal composites deactivated then activated audio with aggregate median 213 ms. The 120 ms deactivation sample is representative, not an aggregate median; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/README.md; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/ha-delay-pause.jsonl; docs/research/callkit-simulator-probe/livecommunicationkit/multicall/hold-accept.jsonl.

unverified: Genuine CallKit multi-call state, choices, capability gating, failures and capacity behavior; these LCK measurements must not replace CallKit policy.
Concrete CXTransaction identifiers and action grouping; LCK exposes neither transaction identifiers nor group membership.
Application-authored composite pause/resume transactions and system UI Swap.
Per-group application-owned media/group membership effects, and capacity admission errors beyond the measured outgoing Start code 7.
Expiry of LCK actions other than Pause, End and Join; 30 s remains a proposed expiry for those kinds.
Delayed or failed app Resume ordering and generated-End timing beyond the immediately fulfilled 2x1 swap-app capture; runtime scheduling remains gated on successful settlement.

pushReportDeadlineEvidence.measured: Approximate 4.4 s termination and PKPushRegistry crash attribution from the device pass writeup; raw late-5s trace ends alive at4.200 s without a kill event.

do-not-disturb.scope: D3 report errors measured at 2.081 s and 2.070 s. Same-number repeat at 69 s and process survival are documented in the device writeup; the two captures are separate cold launches.

restricted-sharing-mode.scope: Unverified on device. NSError code follows the public incoming-call error identity; 2.07 s is explicit simulator policy borrowed from measured DND timing, not a measurement for this reason.

call-is-protected.scope: Unverified on device. NSError code follows the public incoming-call error identity; 2.07 s is explicit simulator policy borrowed from measured DND timing, not a measurement for this reason.

sensitive-participants.scope: Unverified on device. NSError code follows the public incoming-call error identity; 2.07 s is explicit simulator policy borrowed from measured DND timing, not a measurement for this reason.

lckBlockedNumberEvidence.scope: The blocked number reported successfully and rang. Code 4 is not produced by iOS 27.0 for LCK in these measurements; runtime code 4 is an explicit injectable fault only.
